description: Execute a live HTTP request for API/network PoC validation (10s default timeout). Returns status, headers, and body (truncated at 256KB). Include finding_id matching submit_agent_findings — any completed HTTP response (including 4xx/5xx) records the PoC as executed for VERIFIED.

body.description: Optional request body (raw string; use with POST/PUT/PATCH).

finding_id.description: The ID of the finding you are verifying (e.g. api-bola-idor). Must match the id used in submit_agent_findings.

headers.description: Optional request headers as string key/value pairs.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, or OPTIONS.

url.description: Full http:// or https:// URL to request (including path and query).

workspace_path.description: Repository root (for consistency with other verification tools).

name: execute_live_poc
